dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: Lohen is the Vice Captain of the 5th Company... Though honestly, he might as well be our Captain!

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: I'm not sure if you've heard already, but Captain Lohen's as merciless as a howling blizzard toward his enemies. The way he treats his subordinates, on the other hand...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...is as warm and gentle as the spring breeze?

dialogues.speaker: Ekbert
dialogues.text: No, he's still as cold as a blizzard. Just recalling it has sobered me right up.
